public_rationale: The April 16, 2025 CRS report identifies possible antitrust constraints on AI companies [e1]. It does not document a failure of the described control strategy or establish whether model-business returns were adequate [e1]. This evidence establishes neither that inadequate returns are necessary for failure nor a counterexample involving failure despite adequate returns [e1].
limitations: The evidence provides no defined failure event, financial sufficiency measure, or causal comparison.
Possible legal intervention does not establish an actual alternative cause of failure.
The claim specifies neither a returns threshold nor a deadline.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Big tech's master plan to monopolize AI models falls apart only when the models trained on their monopolized hardware do not provide the business returns needed to justify their existence.
conditions: only when the models fail to provide business returns that justify their existence

statement.excerpt: This master plan only falls apart when the “thing” that needs to be trained using hardware that they monopolize doesn’t actually provide the business returns that they need to justify its existence.

from_speaker: This master plan only falls apart when
doesn’t actually provide the business returns

our_interpretation: The surrounding text identifies the plan as durable control over access to AI models through infrastructure and model ownership.
'Only when' makes inadequate business returns a necessary condition for failure. It does not assert that every episode of inadequate returns causes failure.
This is a general causal assertion, not a forecast that failure will occur by a particular date.
Adequate returns means returns sufficient to sustain the model business, without imposing an unstated profit margin or accounting measure.
criteria.support_condition: Observed strategy outcomes and credible causal evidence establish that inadequate model-business returns are necessary for failure, including examination of competing explanations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented failure of the described control strategy occurs while its models deliver adequate business returns, with evidence establishing both facts.
